proposed_cells.old: Allows PUC to assess actual processing costs to public-utility data center customers seeking contract deviations or electric service agreements; applies to data centers with 10 MW or greater peak demand and includes digital-currency mining in the definition.
proposed_cells.new: Authorizes the PUC to assess a public-utility customer the actual costs of processing a request for approval of a contract with deviations or other electric service agreement for a data center with at least 10 MW peak demand; the definition includes digital-currency mining.

proposed_cells.old: Defines data centers at 10 MW or greater; requires separate electric-service terms so data centers reimburse fairly attributed utility costs; bars state preemption of local data center ordinances and resolutions; requires local water-provider compatibility determinations and semiannual water reporting.
proposed_cells.new: Defines data centers at 10 MW or greater; requires separate electric-service terms and reimbursement of fairly attributed costs, including departure or material load reduction; protects local authority to regulate data centers; requires water-provider notice and compatibility determinations, Board of Water Management allocation limits, and semiannual public water-use reporting.
